articles.title: Talisay City murder: Bones, drugs, firearms found in suspect’s home
articles.description: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Suspected human bone fragments, firearms and illegal drugs were recovered from the residence of a 47-year-old man identified by police as the primary suspect in the killing of a caregiver whose severed head was found in Talisay City, Cebu. The items were recovered during the implementation of court-issued search warrants at the suspect’s residence in Barangay San Isidro on Saturday, August 8. Talisay City Police Station chief Police Lieutenant Colonel Homobuno Sayon said the bone fragments recovered from the property would undergo forensic examination as investigators continue searching for the victim’s remains.
